description: ResendSignerInvite rotates a signer's token and re-emails the signing link to the persisted signer email. Founder-gated.  Exposed. The earlier reason for holding it closed — "mints a token" — did not describe the risk: ResendSignerInviteResponse is empty, so the token reaches the signer by email and never the caller. The real effect is rotation: every link emailed to that signer earlier stops working, which is why this carries WRITE risk rather than being treated as a read.
name: signature_resend_signer_invite
title: Resend Signer Invite
